_note: Verified NPC names and roles only. Add anyone you meet in your booklets/cards. 'voice' null means the app assigns a stable voice by name.

npcs.name: Winvarle
npcs.wants: The Keep to survive. Wants the Caves of Chaos dealt with.
knows: There are caves a few miles out, and the things in them are organised
npcs.notes: Quest-giver. Briefs the party on the Caves.

npcs.name: Bartho
knows: The castellan is looking for capable people
npcs.notes: One of the pair who intercept arrivals.

npcs.name: Gala
npcs.notes: The sharper of the two guards. Good first social encounter.

npcs.name: Haldryck
knows: How the Keep works and who to talk to
The road between the Keep and the caves
npcs.notes: Met on the Game Trail, then found at the traveller's inn (area 8). Natural ally / hireling for a two-PC table.

npcs.name: Mallyn
npcs.notes: Appears on later trips along the trail. Useful rumour dispenser.

npcs.name: Pral
npcs.wants: Cargo, coin, and to be feared.
npcs.notes: Bandit Ambush on the trail. If he survives and wins, make him a recurring antagonist — excellent thread for a small party.

npcs.name: Ivlis
npcs.role: Leader of the Cult of Chaos
npcs.wants: The Chaos Bell's power, and the Keep broken.
knows: The cult network in the caves
npcs.secret: Was the previous priest of the Keep's temple (area 11) before leaving under mysterious circumstances.
npcs.notes: The campaign's antagonist. Seed her early via the temple and cult encounters.

npcs.name: Oggdug
npcs.wants: Payment, and revenge for his brother.
knows: Which caves are off-limits and why
npcs.secret: His brother Zurf was killed by the owlbear in Cave G and then reanimated by cultists to guard Cave K.
npcs.notes: Recruitable. Ask about the off-limits caves and he talks about the cult. Huge asset for two players.

npcs.name: Zurf
npcs.wants: Nothing. He is not in control.
npcs.secret: Killed by the owlbear in Cave G, reanimated by cultists, now a bodyguard in Cave K.
npcs.notes: Emotional payoff for Oggdug's thread. Play the recognition, not just the statblock.
